admission.justification: A future lane change must not certify absence or coverage merely because relevant knowledge could not be read.

alternatives.option: Keep Unknown when the relevant parse/knowledge failure prevents establishing a non-text change attribution.
alternatives.reason: Appendix151 calls Unknown the truthful class in this case. The lane reads one shared classifier, preserves non-text gate linkage and measured/partial/unavailable distinctions, and passes the deciding reason rather than guessing.

alternatives.option: Treat the unreadable attribution as confirmed no invariant or as established attribution to eliminate Unknown.
alternatives.reason: Failure to establish a fact is neither observed absence nor observed coverage; either replacement would invent a classification.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The formerly unavailable relevant knowledge is measured successfully, or an approved requirement provides another authoritative attribution source without inferring absence from failure.

consequences: A future lane change must not certify absence or coverage merely because relevant knowledge could not be read.
Not every parse problem makes every path unknown; the gate and reviewer can differ under their explicit exact-recorded-range versus mapped-range rules.
context: Approved MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6 require this by-design choice to be recorded, not deferred as a gap. Source obligation: MIK-R57@v2 by-design parse-unknown. This is the requirement-prescribed boundary, not a claim that an undocumented alternative was seriously weighed.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18/D47/D48; Curator records the specified boundary under constrains_future_work.
